identity_rule: Сначала связать match slot, account id и источник identity; nickname и утверждение пользователя отдельно от подтверждения.

observation_fields.game_time_seconds: signed seconds relative to game start or null
observation_fields.time_source: native replay HUD / parsed tick with documented conversion
observation_fields.evidence: local frame/clip path + SHA256 / source record + parser revision
observation_fields.view_mode: player POV / spectator all vision / metadata / unknown
observation_fields.context: phase, actor hero/role, position, resources, lane/wave/objectives; unknown kept null
observation_fields.observed_action: literal visible or parsed action, never intent
observation_fields.outcome: observed result within explicit horizon; censored if no later evidence
observation_fields.intent_hypothesis: optional hypothesis with alternatives, never fact
observation_fields.normalization_gate: c1-replay-gate-v1 only for compatible normalized events; manual record is separate

feature_groups.name: farm
feature_groups.observable: lane/jungle occupancy, last hits/denies if HUD/source supports, farm route, time away from available farm
feature_groups.limit: GPM is aggregate; motive and available alternatives require context

feature_groups.name: movement
feature_groups.observable: positions/time intervals, transitions, rotations, retreat, group proximity
feature_groups.limit: spectator paths do not show player camera, clicks or attention

feature_groups.name: targets
feature_groups.limit: unseen targets and selected unit alone are not actual issued commands

feature_groups.name: purchases
feature_groups.observable: inventory changes and timestamped purchase events if available
feature_groups.limit: inventory acquisition alone can be delivery/transfer; exact intention is unknown

feature_groups.name: threat_response
feature_groups.limit: temporal order is not causality; invisible threat excluded from player feature context

feature_groups.name: team_interaction
feature_groups.limit: not evidence of friendliness, morale or private communication

horizon_policy: Descriptive candidates, no success thresholds fitted; do not search for best horizon on final test.
coverage_rule: Per feature numerator of observable eligible episodes and denominator + exclusions; do not invent overall 0..1 from viewed minutes.

heldout.this_match: exploratory/train candidate because examined now; never untouched final test later
heldout.future: Freeze train/validation/test match IDs after receipt and duplicate/patch/hero audit, before tuning. Final test not used for event selection/thresholds. No split claimed yet.

gate_limitations: current gate omits time/context/outcome/confidence; retain separate documentary observations, no source schema extension here
current hidden/future booleans are input assertions, not independent authorization or validation of replay vision
compatible parser not selected by this analyst; native replay viewing is not parser acceptance
forbidden_conclusions: personality, friendliness, morale or psychological state from replay
available enemy knowledge from omniscient spectator view
reliable response latency from sparse screenshots
skill rating or fixed trait from one result
next_steps: root verifies replay availability/version and actor identity
root captures actual native timestamped observations with view mode
analysts fill evidence records; separate descriptive tendency from hypothesis
cross-check observed episode against replay/metadata where available
